function.name: run_sql
function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT vb.vendor_id, v.vendor_name FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor_bill vb JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON vb.vendor_id = v.vendor_id WHERE vb.vendor_invoice_no = 'MRP-88213' LIMIT 1","purpose":"Get vendor details for duplicate invoice"}
